added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite-1795337093827978496.log reports 58 passed with no FAILED ids at 50e7ad10, after_suite-1795337136506609182.log reports 62 passed with no FAILED ids at 500a426c, so the head-minus-base failure difference is empty.

findings.text: on a cold store the detail view now skips _index_discovery entirely, so the assembled blocker_state is absent and reckon/mcp_views.py:3051 falls back to _blocking(data, deps), which omits sprint, released-blocker and held-path rows; a client that only ever issues detail reads never warms the store, so the loss is not limited to the first read after a restart, and no test in the gate exercises that fallback.

_PersistedPlanStates.get caches only a non-None answer, so a ref that resolves to nothing runs _resolve again on every lookup, which makes the class docstring's 'each slug is resolved at most once per read' false for the unresolved case.

_PersistedPlanStates subclasses dict but overrides only get, so in, [], items(), keys(), values() and len() all report an empty mapping; sound today because the only caller uses get and __setitem__, but any later iteration over it silently sees no plans.
